console.connectFailed: Could not connect to the Wings console
console.diag.intro: The browser console shows the exact reason (F12 → Console). What to look for, in order:
console.diag.csp: — the browser blocked the connection by Content-Security-Policy. The console talks to the Wings node directly, and that is a different domain, so it has to be listed in connect-src on the nginx side.
console.diag.origin: with no mention of CSP — the handshake was refused by Wings itself. It checks the Origin header and by default lets only Pterodactyl in; this panel’s address has to be added to allowed_origins in the Wings config.yml, and Wings restarted. The refusal looks like an HTTP 403 and is not visible in the panel’s logs — the panel takes no part in that exchange.
console.diag.nodeDown: The Wings node is off or unreachable — check it in Pterodactyl.
console.diag.noAccess: The Pterodactyl service user has no access to this server.
console.reconnecting: The console connection dropped — reconnecting. There is no need to reload the page.

ai.help.title: Quick help
ai.help.intro: Answers for the screen you opened help from.
ai.help.aiHint: For a question that is not covered above. AI uses your current permissions.
ai.help.faq.general.navigation.q: Where are the panel's main features?
ai.help.faq.general.navigation.a: Use the sidebar for servers, tickets, messages, access, settings, audit and security. A server's own tools appear after you open it.
ai.help.faq.general.permissions.q: Why can I not see a tab or button?
ai.help.faq.general.permissions.a: The panel only shows actions allowed by your role and assigned servers. A GM can review these permissions in Access.
ai.help.faq.general.safety.a: Stops, restores, file edits, permission changes and money operations can affect players immediately. Read the confirmation and target before proceeding.
ai.help.faq.servers.open.q: How do I manage a server?
ai.help.faq.servers.open.a: Open its card. The server page combines live status, power controls, game tools and Pterodactyl settings.
ai.help.faq.servers.status.q: What do the status and resource values mean?
ai.help.faq.servers.status.a: Status shows whether the process is running. CPU, memory, disk, network and uptime are live measurements from the node.
ai.help.faq.tickets.reply.q: How do I handle a ticket?
ai.help.faq.tickets.reply.a: Open it, read the thread, reply, and close it when the issue is resolved. New activity updates the unread counter.
ai.help.faq.tickets.status.a: The author sees their own ticket. Staff visibility and available actions depend on role permissions.
ai.help.faq.messages.use.a: They are private conversations between panel users. Select a person, write a message and continue the thread in one place.
ai.help.faq.messages.unread.a: The sidebar badge updates live. Opening a conversation marks the messages shown there as read.
ai.help.faq.market.install.q: How do I install a recommended plugin?
ai.help.faq.market.install.a: Choose a compatible package, select a server and confirm installation. A running server may require a restart before the plugin loads.
ai.help.faq.market.compatibility.a: The game module, server type, version or your permissions may not match that package's requirements.
ai.help.faq.access.roles.a: Create staff accounts, assign roles and manage which servers they can see. The role defines available actions.
ai.help.faq.access.servers.q: Can access be limited to selected servers?
ai.help.faq.access.servers.a: Yes. Assign specific servers to an account, or allow all servers when the role requires global access.
ai.help.faq.audit.find.q: How do I find a particular action?
ai.help.faq.audit.find.a: Use the filters for actor, action, target and date. Open an entry to inspect its recorded details.
ai.help.faq.audit.details.q: What is recorded in the audit log?
ai.help.faq.audit.details.a: Administrative changes, their actor, target, result and available context are recorded for accountability.
ai.help.faq.security.totp.a: It protects the account with a rotating code in addition to the password, reducing damage from a stolen password.
ai.help.faq.security.sessions.q: How do I remove an unfamiliar session?
ai.help.faq.security.sessions.a: Revoke it in the session list. If you do not recognize it, also change your password and enable two-factor authentication.
ai.help.faq.settings.profile.q: What can I change in my profile?
ai.help.faq.settings.profile.a: You can change your panel language, nickname and password. These changes affect only your account.
ai.help.faq.settings.language.a: The interface switches immediately and saves the choice to your account for future sessions.
ai.help.faq.settings.accounts.a: They define whether new accounts need approval and which registration paths are available.
ai.help.faq.settings.approvals.a: Review the pending list in this section, then approve or reject each request.
ai.help.faq.settings.mail.a: SMTP sends panel email such as account and alert notifications. Use the test action after changing credentials.
ai.help.faq.settings.alerts.a: Alerts notify configured recipients about selected server or panel events according to the thresholds here.
ai.help.faq.settings.ai.q: What can the AI assistant do?
ai.help.faq.settings.ai.a: It can answer from panel data and propose permitted actions. A proposed change runs only after explicit confirmation.
ai.help.faq.settings.aiLimits.a: Request and token limits cap usage and cost. Model choice trades response quality against speed and price.
ai.help.faq.server.power.q: How do Start, Restart and Stop differ?
ai.help.faq.server.power.a: Start launches an offline process, Restart cycles it, and Stop shuts it down. Check player activity before Restart or Stop.
ai.help.faq.server.module.q: What does the game module change?
ai.help.faq.server.module.a: It connects game-specific players, bans, whitelist and settings tools. It does not replace the server software.
ai.help.faq.server.tabs.q: Why do different servers have different tabs?
ai.help.faq.server.tabs.a: Tabs come from the assigned game module, installed integrations and your permissions. Pterodactyl tabs remain common to all servers.
ai.help.faq.console.command.q: How do I send a console command?
ai.help.faq.console.command.a: Enter the command without a slash and send it. Output appears in the live console above.
ai.help.faq.console.quick.a: They are prepared common commands. Actions that need a target ask for it before execution.
ai.help.faq.players.manage.q: What can I do from the player list?
ai.help.faq.players.manage.a: Open a player to view available details and moderation actions. The exact controls depend on the game and your role.
ai.help.faq.players.details.a: When the module or companion stores known players, offline profiles remain searchable with the actions that support them.
ai.help.faq.bans.manage.q: How do I add or remove a ban?
ai.help.faq.bans.manage.a: Use the ban form with a clear reason and duration when supported. Select an existing record to remove it.
ai.help.faq.bans.scope.q: Does a ban apply to every server?
ai.help.faq.bans.scope.a: Usually it applies only to the open game server. Check the target shown by the form before confirming.
ai.help.faq.whitelist.manage.q: How do I change the whitelist?
ai.help.faq.whitelist.manage.a: Add or remove a player in this tab. The game server applies the updated list through its integration.
ai.help.faq.whitelist.access.q: Does whitelist access replace panel permissions?
ai.help.faq.whitelist.access.a: No. The whitelist controls entry to the game; panel roles control administrative access here.
ai.help.faq.guilds.manage.q: What can be managed for guilds?
ai.help.faq.guilds.manage.a: Inspect guilds, members and available settings. Leadership and staff actions appear only when permitted.
ai.help.faq.guilds.money.a: Integrated guild accounts and their transaction controls appear with guild details when AurumCore is available.
ai.help.faq.economy.accounts.a: Browse player, treasury, guild and service accounts, balances and transaction history by currency.
ai.help.faq.economy.adjust.a: Use credit, debit or forced transfer with an amount and reason. Every operation is handled by AurumCore and audited.
ai.help.faq.map.use.q: What does the live map show?
ai.help.faq.map.use.a: It displays available world data and tracked objects from the game integration. Pan and zoom to inspect an area.
ai.help.faq.map.layers.q: Why can map data be missing?
ai.help.faq.map.layers.a: The server or companion must provide that data. Availability can also depend on module settings and permissions.
ai.help.faq.module.setup.q: What is configured in this tab?
ai.help.faq.module.setup.a: Configure the connection and features specific to this game module, then use its status check before relying on the tools.
ai.help.faq.module.connection.q: Why does the connection test fail?
ai.help.faq.module.connection.a: Check the host, port, credentials, network reachability and the game's remote administration setting.
ai.help.faq.files.edit.q: Can I edit configuration files here?
ai.help.faq.files.edit.a: Yes. Open a text file, edit it and save. Restart the server only when that configuration requires it.
ai.help.faq.files.upload.q: How do uploads and folders work?
ai.help.faq.files.upload.a: Navigate to the target folder before uploading. You can create folders and manage files allowed by Pterodactyl.
ai.help.faq.backups.create.q: When should I create a backup?
ai.help.faq.backups.create.a: Create one before updates, major configuration changes or risky world operations, and wait for completion.
ai.help.faq.backups.restore.q: What happens when a backup is restored?
ai.help.faq.backups.restore.a: Current server files are replaced by the selected snapshot. Stop the server and verify the correct backup first.
ai.help.faq.network.allocations.a: It is an IP and port assigned to the server. Additional allocations can expose other game or service ports.
ai.help.faq.network.primary.q: What does the primary allocation do?
ai.help.faq.network.primary.a: It is the default address displayed for the server. Changing it can affect how players connect.
ai.help.faq.startup.variables.a: They configure the server image and launch command. Change only values supported by the selected egg.
ai.help.faq.startup.command.a: Most apply on the next start or restart. Invalid values can prevent the process from launching.
ai.help.faq.databases.create.a: Plugins and applications use them for persistent data. Create one only when the software requires it.
ai.help.faq.databases.credentials.q: How should database credentials be handled?
ai.help.faq.databases.credentials.a: Treat them as secrets. Put them only in the intended server configuration and rotate them if exposed.
ai.help.faq.schedules.create.a: It can run power actions, commands or backups at configured times without manual intervention.
ai.help.faq.schedules.tasks.q: How do tasks inside a schedule run?
ai.help.faq.schedules.tasks.a: Tasks run in order with their configured delays. Review the sequence before enabling a destructive schedule.
